visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a vertical 9:16 frame, the scene opens with the back of a woman's head; her dark brown short hair appears frizzy and unstyled against a blurred wooden background. A text overlay '[Before]' appears on the top left. (2) After a quick cut, the woman's hair is now shown perfectly straight and glossy from the same back-facing angle; the text overlay changes to '[After]' while '毛躁不順' is replaced with '拉直亮澤'. (3) The main character, a young woman with a short bob and light skin, faces the camera in a living room; she wears a white t-shirt and holds a dark blue and copper Dyson hair styling tool, smiling and speaking with high energy. (4) The scene shifts to a bathroom where the woman is drying her hair with a light gray towel; she looks into the mirror, expressing a tired or frustrated facial expression while pointing at her hair. (5) Close-up shots follow, showing the woman using the Dyson Airstrait on damp hair; her hands grip the device as it glides down a section of hair, emitting visible light from its digital interface. (6) Detailed close-up shots of the hair tool's LCD screen display temperature settings like '115°C' and '100°C' along with icons for fan speed and drying modes while her thumb interacts with the physical buttons. (7) A sequence of her styling different sections of her hair; the tool clamps onto the hair and moves smoothly, showing the immediate transition from damp/frizz to straight/shiny as airflow interacts with the strands. (8) The woman is shown taking a selfie using a smartphone while holding the styling tool near her face; she winks at the camera, demonstrating high satisfaction with her sleek and glossy hair. (9) The final phase shows the woman holding the tool in front of her while smiling widely in a brightly lit indoor environment; extensive text overlays summarize the product's benefits as she makes direct eye contact.
